title: Formation Arrays
description: an api to bring formations to minecraft
body:
# Formation Arrays

bring formations to minecraft using this dedicated API 
- create and manage custom formations 
- let formations communicate with eachother
- Access token capability for custom behaviour for team mods
- Formation plate cabapility built in
- Formation power source capability built in

## Planned features
- datapack support
- custom connection types
- let ports and connections automaticly cast types
